```{r}
source("SMT_Data_Starter.R")
runner_tracks <- readRDS("runner_tracks.rds")
steal_attempts <- readRDS("steal_attempts.rds")
```

## Gathering instantaneous speeds of runners

```{r}
runner_tracks <- runner_tracks %>%
  arrange(game_string, play_per_game, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(game_string, play_per_game) %>%
  mutate(
    dt = (timestamp - lag(timestamp)) / 1000,
    dx = field_x - lag(field_x),
    dy = field_y - lag(field_y),
    speed = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) / dt,
    speed_3frame_avg = slider::slide_dbl(
      speed,
      mean,
      .before = 1,
      .after = 1,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Top speeds during each play:

```{r}
top_speed <- runner_tracks %>%
  group_by(game_string, play_per_game) %>%
  summarize(
    top_speed = max(speed_3frame_avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

steal_attempts <- steal_attempts %>%
  left_join(top_speed,
            by = c("game_string", "play_per_game"))
```

# Keeping only first few tenths of a second

```{r}
runner_tracks <- runner_tracks %>%
  mutate(
    time_since_pitch =
      (timestamp - pitch_timestamp)/1000
  )

```

# Jump metric:

```{r}
jump_metric <- runner_tracks %>%
  filter(
    time_since_pitch >= 0,
    time_since_pitch <= 0.4
  ) %>%
  group_by(game_string, play_per_game) %>%
  summarize(
    speed_at_release = speed[which.min(abs(time_since_pitch))],
    speed_at_0_4 = speed[which.min(abs(time_since_pitch - 0.4))],
    jump = speed_at_0_4 - speed_at_release,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
steal_attempts <- steal_attempts %>%
  select(-any_of(c("jump", "jump.x", "jump.y"))) %>%
  left_join(
    jump_metric,
    by = c("game_string", "play_per_game")
  )
```

## Good looking leaderboard (all in one):

```{r}
## Flexible scoreboard leaderboard system

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

## Setting up logic that works for any of the 4 categories

metric_settings <- tibble::tribble(
  ~metric_id,           ~metric_col,   ~player_col, ~board_title,              ~board_subtitle,                                      ~unit,          ~higher_is_better, ~priority,
  "runner_top_speed",   "top_speed",   "runner",    "TOP RUNNER SPEEDS",       "Fastest sustained bursts during steal attempts",     "ft/s",         TRUE,              1,
  "runner_jump",        "jump",        "runner",    "BEST RUNNER JUMPS",       "Most speed gained in the first 0.4 seconds",         "ft/s gained",  TRUE,              2,
  "catcher_pop_time",   "pop_time",    "catcher",   "FASTEST POP TIMES",       "Quickest catcher throws to the target base",         "sec",          FALSE,             3,
  "catcher_throw_velo", "throw_velo",  "catcher",   "HARDEST CATCHER THROWS",  "Highest catcher throw velocities on steal attempts", "mph",          TRUE,              4
)

## Building Leaderboard

build_metric_leaderboard <- function(data, metric_id, metric_col, player_col,
                                     board_title, board_subtitle, unit,
                                     higher_is_better, priority) {
  
  if (!metric_col %in% names(data)) return(tibble())
  if (!player_col %in% names(data)) player_col <- "runner"
  
  metric_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      outcome %in% c("Safe", "Out"),
      !is.na(.data[[metric_col]])
    )
   
  if (higher_is_better) {
    metric_data <- metric_data %>% arrange(desc(.data[[metric_col]]))
  } else {
    metric_data <- metric_data %>% arrange(.data[[metric_col]])
  }
  
  metric_data %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      metric_id = metric_id,
      player_id = as.character(.data[[player_col]]),
      board_title = board_title,
      board_subtitle = board_subtitle,
      priority = priority,
      metric_value = round(.data[[metric_col]], 2),
      metric_label = paste(metric_value, unit)
    ) %>%
    select(
      metric_id,
      board_title,
      board_subtitle,
      priority,
      rank,
      game_string,
      play_per_game,
      player_id,
      outcome,
      metric_value,
      metric_label
    )
}

all_leaderboard_triggers <- pmap_dfr(
  metric_settings,
  \(metric_id, metric_col, player_col, board_title, board_subtitle,
    unit, higher_is_better, priority) {
    
    build_metric_leaderboard(
      data = steal_attempts,
      metric_id = metric_id,
      metric_col = metric_col,
      player_col = player_col,
      board_title = board_title,
      board_subtitle = board_subtitle,
      unit = unit,
      higher_is_better = higher_is_better,
      priority = priority
    )
  }
)

# Scoreboard Graphic

make_scoreboard_leaderboard <- function(board_data,
                                        highlight_game = NULL,
                                        highlight_play = NULL,
                                        output_file = NULL) {
  
  if (nrow(board_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  plot_data <- board_data %>%
    arrange(rank) %>%
    mutate(
      y = 9.35 - (row_number() - 1) * 0.85,
      rank_label = paste0("#", rank),
      player_label = paste0("Player ", player_id),
      highlight = game_string == highlight_game & play_per_game == highlight_play
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = y)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#07111F") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 100, ymin = 10.95, ymax = 12.4,
             fill = "#12355B") +
    
    annotate("text", x = 50, y = 11.8, label = board_data$board_title[1],
             color = "white", size = 13, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 50, y = 11.2, label = board_data$board_subtitle[1],
             color = "#D8E2F3", size = 5.5) +
    
    annotate("text", x = 12, y = 10.45, label = "RANK",
             color = "#AFC4E8", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 40, y = 10.45, label = "PLAYER",
             color = "#AFC4E8", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 78, y = 10.45, label = "VALUE",
             color = "#AFC4E8", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
    
    geom_rect(
      aes(xmin = 5, xmax = 95, ymin = y - 0.34, ymax = y + 0.34,
          fill = highlight),
      color = "#E8EEF7",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "#0B1B2B", "TRUE" = "#D99A25"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    
    geom_text(aes(x = 12, label = rank_label),
              color = "white", size = 7, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(aes(x = 40, label = player_label),
              color = "white", size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(aes(x = 78, label = metric_label),
              color = "white", size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
    
    annotate("text", x = 50, y = 0.35,
             label = "STOLEN BASE SPOTLIGHT | LIVE TRACKING LEADERBOARD",
             color = "#AFC4E8", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
    
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 12.4), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void()
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    ggsave(output_file, p, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 150)
  }
  
  p
}

# Demo function

show_live_scoreboard <- function(game_id, play_id, output_file = NULL) {
  
  triggered <- all_leaderboard_triggers %>%
    filter(
      .data$game_string == .env$game_id,
      .data$play_per_game == .env$play_id
    ) %>%
    arrange(rank, priority)
  
  if (nrow(triggered) == 0) {
    message("No top-10 leaderboard triggered for this play.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  board_to_show <- all_leaderboard_triggers %>%
    filter(metric_id == triggered$metric_id[1]) %>%
    arrange(rank)
  
  make_scoreboard_leaderboard(
    board_data = board_to_show,
    highlight_game = game_id,
    highlight_play = play_id,
    output_file = output_file
  )
}
```

## Example use case:

```{r}
show_live_scoreboard(
  game_id = 'y1_d181_LRQ_ARN',
  play_id = 230,
  output_file = "scoreboard_demo.png"
)
```





## Setting up data for modeling

```{r}
modeling_data <- steal_attempts %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(top_speed),
    !is.na(jump),
    !is.na(outcome)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_model = if_else(outcome == "Safe", "Safe", "Out"),
    safe_binary = if_else(outcome == "Safe", 1, 0),
    outcome_factor = factor(outcome_model, levels = c("Out", "Safe"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    game_string,
    play_per_game,
    runner,
    outcome,
    outcome_model,
    safe_binary,
    outcome_factor,
    top_speed,
    jump
  )

saveRDS(modeling_data, "steal_modeling_data.rds")
```
